body: Context: brief asked for dotenv extends where it makes sense. Chosen: none; the same Includer already loads dotenv bases and callers layer .env files (Compose env_file, envkit). Alternative: a '# @extends' comment directive. Reason: invented syntax other dotenv readers silently ignore gives different variables per reader, a silent-wrong-config risk. Revisit only as a syntax-free API option (WithBases) if a tool needs it.
title: No dotenv $extends syntax
